notes: MISSING PARENT LINK (research 2026-07-03, plausible, not certain): this record has no parents listed, but is identifiable as a son of Elisha Coffin Sr. (I182381536354) and Eunice Myrick — i.e. Elisha Coffin Jr. of Savage Harbour, PEI, and a sibling of Eunice Coffin (I182197770003). Evidence: islandregister.com's PEI Coffin narrative refers to 'Elisha Jr.'s son Benjamin' continuing to hold the original Savage Harbour homestead, and a distinct WikiTree profile 'Elisha Coffin Jr (1763–1851)' (Coffin-2357) exists for this person. This is NOT a duplicate of Elisha Coffin Sr. (different birth/death years and generation) but a genuine, separate individual whose parent-link is simply missing from this tree.
